definitions.explanation: the profit before deducting operating expenses, calculated as revenue minus cost of goods sold

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{粗利|あらり}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧30%だ。
examples.english: The gross margin on this product is 30%.

examples.english: In a high-volume, low-margin strategy, you make money through sales volume even though gross profit is low.

notes:
{粗利|あらり} is a business/accounting term for gross profit, the profit before subtracting operating expenses.

WRITING:
- {粗|あら} (rough, coarse)
- ⟦{利|り}→利：29142_ri⟧ (profit, benefit)

ALTERNATIVE READING:
- Also written as {粗利|そり} or {粗利益|あらりえき}/{粗利益|そりえき}

CALCULATION:
- {粗利|あらり} = ⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧ (sales) - ⟦{原価|げんか}→原価：05470_genka⟧ (cost of goods)
- {粗利|あらり}{率|りつ} (gross margin rate/percentage)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {粗利|あらり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ (high gross margin)
- {粗利|あらり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確保|かくほ}→確保：13681_kakuho⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to secure gross profit)
- {粗利|あらり}{率|りつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{改善|かいぜん}する→改善する：26828_kaizensuru⟧ (to improve gross margin)

RELATED WORDS:
- {純利|じゅんり}/⟦{純利益|じゅんりえき}→純利益：18911_junrieki⟧ (net profit)
- ⟦{営業|えいぎょう}{利益|りえき}→営業利益：22690_eigyourieki⟧ (operating profit)
- ⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧{総|そう}{利益|りえき} (gross profit - formal term)
